At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

* Built or integrated AI/ML features into products and systems, including recommendation engines, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, RAG pipelines, and agents
* Successfully led modernisation and replatforming efforts to align legacy systems with short and long-term business needs
* Led and delivered solutions to architecture-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability
* Facilitated alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders to move initiatives forward through ambiguity and complexity
* Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback
## **What You’ll Do At 8th Light**
As a go-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:
* Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives
* Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long-term technical vision to what ships
* Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long-term vision to what ships
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
* Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Designing and managing high-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
* Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
* Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
* Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
* Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre-sales scope shaping
* Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep-dives to improve team and project outcomes
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
* Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform- or product-oriented development
* Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
* Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:
* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on

* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n

* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code
Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences.

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future.
* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:

* Coworking support for our global team
* 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees
See our full list of Benefits.

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.

8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

# Senior Programme Manager – Certification
AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.
Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record of over 67 days in the stratosphere. From above 60,000+ft, or 20km above ground, AALTO can deliver several applications including direct-to-device connectivity and high-resolution Earth observation.
AALTO operates in a new operational layer between most of air traffic and low-Earth orbit, Stratospace. This is where high-altitude platforms led by Zephyr deliver services to commercial and government partners. We can help monitor environments, observe borders, track natural disasters and connect unconnected communities.
Join us as we create a new domain of aerospace: Stratospace. You’ll be part of a highly-skilled, innovative and passionate group of people – Team AALTO. Together, we can Unlock Stratospace.
**About The Role**
As **Senior Programme Manager – Certification**, you will be accountable for leading the end-to-end certification programme for Zephyr, ensuring delivery against agreed schedule, budget, quality and regulatory requirements. This is a role for someone who can operate confidently at senior level while remaining close enough to the detail to intervene when complex certification, technical or programme issues require experienced judgement.
Reporting to the Director of Programmes and supported by Programme Controls, you will establish the certification programme plan, drive governance, align stakeholders and ensure the organisation is ready to move from certification into entry into service. You will be the senior programme interface for certification delivery, working closely with the UK CAA and other relevant civil or military aviation authorities.
For an experienced aerospace professional, this is a rare chance to shape the certification approach for a platform operating in a new aviation layer between conventional air traffic and low-Earth orbit.
**Responsibilities to include:**
###### **Programme Planning** and **Governance**
· Own the Certification Programme Plan, including strategy, compliance approach, milestones, dependencies and baseline.
· Build an integrated schedule covering design, analysis, test, manufacturing readiness, certification and entry into service.
· Chair governance forums to drive decisions, manage risk, close actions and align stakeholders.
· Manage risks, issues, opportunities and dependencies, ensuring ownership, mitigation and timely escalation.
###### **Certification Leadership**
· Act as the main programme interface with the UK CAA and other relevant aviation authorities.
· Lead certification strategies, plans, reviews and approval activities from development through execution.
· Guide the Certification Basis, Means of Compliance, Special Conditions, Equivalent Safety Findings and authority agreements.
· Oversee certification artefacts, ensuring they are complete, credible, traceable and ready for authority review.
· Lead critical certification discussions, issue resolution and recovery actions where senior judgement is required.
###### **Technical and Compliance Coordination**
• Lead cross-functional teams to deliver compliance evidence across engineering, airworthiness, quality, manufacturing, operations, cybersecurity and support.
• Drive closure of the Compliance Checklist against applicable airworthiness and certification requirements.
• Maintain traceability across requirements, compliance methods, test evidence, analysis, conformity records and statements.
• Oversee certification ground and flight test activities, including planning, conformity inspections, authority witnessing and evidence closure.
• Ensure compliance packages are robust, auditable, configuration controlled and ready for review.
• Drive readiness to manufacture, operate, maintain and support certified aircraft.
###### **Stakeholder** and **Resource Management**
· Manage relationships across internal teams, suppliers, partners, customers and certification authorities.
· Lead resource planning and prioritisation across certification workstreams with functional leaders.
· Report clearly on performance, certification status, risks, decisions and recovery actions to senior leadership.
· Coordinate transition from certification to entry into service across airworthiness, quality, manufacturing, operations and support.
· Support post-certification activities, including continued airworthiness, MMEL and maintenance or training approvals where applicable.
###### **Continuous Improvement and Change Management**
· Improve programme delivery, governance and certification processes.
· Support programme standards, best practice and effective change control.
· Use digital tools and automation to improve efficiency, transparency and reporting.
**Skills and Knowledge Required**
* Degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline; advanced degree, or equivalent professional experience will be considered an asset.
* Demonstrable extensive experience in aircraft design, certification, airworthiness and in managing aerospace programmes both in Civil or Military environment .
* Proven track record leading, or playing a senior hands-on role in, a major aircraft, platform or aerospace product certification programme with a recognised civil or military aviation authority.
* Strong practical knowledge of certification planning, Certification Basis development, Means of Compliance, compliance demonstration, conformity, certification documentation and authority engagement.
* Working knowledge of applicable airworthiness and certification requirements, Part 21 organisational requirements and type certification processes.
* Familiarity with systems engineering, safety assessment, software and hardware assurance standards, including ARP4754A, ARP4761, DO-178C and DO-254, or equivalent military standards.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders.
* Programme management capability, including governance, reporting, change control, schedule, budget and risk management; PMP, APM, PRINCE2 or equivalent desirable.
* Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, particularly with regulatory bodies.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, translating complex technical, regulatory, operational and commercial considerations into clear decisions and executive-level communications.
* Comfortable operating without established processes and making decisions with incomplete information. Able to create clarity, drive execution, and scale ways of working as the business grows.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
* **Owning three health systems, not one region:** building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
* **Selling at every level:** running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
* **Winning the technical argument:** these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
* **Turning pilots into contracts:** generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
* **Using data to pick your battles:** building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
* **Building the playbook:** leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.

* **You are a proven deal-closer** with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
* **You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range,** equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.

* **You are data-led** and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
* **You are a self-starter** who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
* **You are mission-driven** and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.

# Senior Partner Development Manager
## Sometimes the chance comes up to be part of something really special, at Acquired you’ll be collaborating with teams and people who challenge you, support you, and inspire you to be extraordinary.
**We’re Acquired**
Acquired is a next-generation payments business focused on powering recurring commerce.
Our next-generation payment infrastructure and solutions unify and optimise customers' payment ecosystem, providing a competitive advantage and helping them achieve their goals in the digital economy.
We combine this capability with exceptional sector expertise and a highly personal, tailored service focused on long-term partnerships with our customers.
We’re scaling as a business, so if you thrive in an environment that’s constantly evolving, where purpose-driven culture is seen as an enabler to achieve the extraordinary and where our unique differences are celebrated, we could be the place for you!
---
###### **Role Overview**
The Senior Partner Development Manager – Financial Services is a hybrid role within the Commercial team, combining hands-on management of our existing Financial Services partner ecosystem with the origination of new platform (ISV), SI, and consultancy partnerships. Reporting directly to the Head of Partnerships FS, you'll grow revenue both by deepening current partnerships and by building a pipeline of net-new strategic partners across Debt Recovery, Lending, Insurance and Wealth Management.
This role blends account management with business development. You'll need the relationship discipline to nurture and grow an existing portfolio, and the entrepreneurial drive to open new doors from a cold start.
Critically, every new partner you sign is also a new lead source: you're responsible for activating each one as a genuine channel for the direct sales team, not just landing a logo.
---
###### **Key Responsibilities**
**Account Management & Growth**
* Manage a portfolio of existing FS partnerships, conducting regular performance reviews and identifying untapped revenue opportunities within their client bases.
* Act as the primary liaison between partners, the internal SDR Outreach Engine, and the direct sales team to ensure a consistent flow of qualified leads.
* Monitor “Net Revenue” performance per existing partner, accounting for direct costs and bad debt provisions to ensure high-quality growth.
**New Partner Origination & Recruitment**
* Build and own a pipeline of net-new FS platform (ISV), SI, and consultancy partners across Debt Recovery, Lending, Insurance, and Wealth Management.
* Proactively identify and approach target partners, using market mapping, networking, and outbound prospecting to build relationships from a cold start.
* Qualify potential partners against strategic fit, market reach, and revenue potential before progressing to commercial discussions.
**Channel Activation for Direct Sales**
* Activate every new partner as a lead-generation channel for the direct sales team, embedding referral processes that turn signed agreements into a consistent flow of qualified pipeline.
* Work with Sales leadership to define how partner-sourced opportunities are routed, prioritised, and followed up, so partners become a repeatable source of new business rather than one-off wins.
* Track partner-sourced pipeline and conversion into Sales, using the data to prove out and expand the channel over time.
**Deal Structuring & Commercial Negotiation**
* Lead commercial negotiations with prospective partners, structuring agreements that balance mutual value, referral economics, and long-term revenue potential.
* **Own the “Net Revenue” business case** for each new partnership, factoring in direct costs and bad debt provisions to ensure high-quality growth from day one.
* Work cross-functionally with Legal and Finance to get new partnership agreements signed and ready for launch**.**
**Launch & Enablement**
* Own onboarding and enablement of new partners, ensuring they're fully trained on the Acquired value proposition (Recurring Payments, Smart Recovery and VRP) before go-live.
* Partner closely with the scoping/solutions team to translate new partnerships into live, revenue-generating integrations.
* Transition newly-launched partners smoothly into ongoing account management once they're live and generating leads.
**Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting**
* Maintain clean, accurate data in HubSpot across both the existing partner book and the new-partner pipeline, providing the Head of Partnerships with reliable forecasting.
* Report on origination KPIs (partners approached, signed, launched) alongside existing-partner growth and downstream revenue impact.
**Market Advocacy & Intelligence**
* Represent Acquired at key industry events (e.g., IFX, SubscriptionX) to build a pipeline of relationships with FS platforms and SIs.
* Track competitor partner programs and market shifts, feeding intelligence back to Product to influence the FS roadmap.
---
###### **Key Competencies**
* **Relationship Management:** Ability to build deep trust with complex FS stakeholders and sustain it over the life of the partnership.
* **Channel Building:** Able to turn a signed partner into a genuine, repeatable pipeline source for the direct sales team — not just a logo on a slide.
* **Entrepreneurial Drive:** Comfortable building a partner pipeline from zero — thrives on the hunt for new logos as much as growing existing ones.
* **Deal-Making**: Skilled negotiator who can structure commercial agreements that work for both sides.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Understands the Net Revenue model and bad debt impacts on FS deals, and uses it to prioritise both the existing book and the pipeline.
* **Communication:** Able to articulate technical payment concepts (VRP, cVRP, API logic) clearly to non-technical commercial audiences.
---
###### **You’ll Bring**
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Partnership, Channel Sales, or Business Development, ideally within Payments or FinTech, with a track record spanning both portfolio management and new-partner origination.

**About Preserving the historical documents of Moscow Mill and its community, and making repairs and adjustments so the Heritage Centre can re-open and be accessible to everyone project.**
By the end of June 2027, the Heritage Centre will have reopened, the heritage will have been restored, and the site will be accessible to all. Volunteers and stakeholders will have been engaged throughout the process and offered heritage training to help protect the future of the heritage. The sustainability of the Heritage Centre will be supported initially through grants from Accrington Heritage Trust and subsequently from the new charity that is to be formed within this project.
This will be achieved by:
1. Organising the repair of the roof and the access door.
2. Advertising and recruitment of a freelance Project Manager to coordinate activities and tasks.
3. Advertising and recruitment of a freelance Multi-Lingual Project Manager to ensure the stories of the Asian community who worked in mills are included in the collection.
4. Packing up the collections in all rooms and logging them as they are packed. Initial cleaning, covering, and uncovering of the looms during the building works.
5. Sourcing secure storage – several metal lockable cupboards, packing materials and boxes.
6. Providing training, information and involvement of volunteers (up to 12) to be provided with four training sessions from Lancashire Archive. This will include Introduction to Collection Care & Packing collections, Basic Cataloguing of Collections Documentation, and Hazards in Museum Collections. These sessions will be delivered at the site.
7. Two days of supervision of volunteers to undertake cataloguing and packing.
8. Collaboration with the Steering Group to ensure ongoing support and smooth coordination of the project.
9. Collaboration with a local school to develop a modern education pack aligned with the current Local History topic within the curriculum for Years 1 and 2 that can be incorporated into their studies
10. Engagement with the Steering group, and 8 other local primary schools within the Mills footprint, community groups, Hyndburn Borough Council and stakeholders.
11. Working with Accrington Heritage Trust to apply for grants for the upkeep of the Heritage Centre until a charity can be formed, plus phase 2 funding.

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced AWS Connect Developer to design, develop, configure, integrate, and support solutions built on Amazon Connect. The role requires strong hands-on experience across contact-centre functionality, customer journeys, Cases, Tasks, Contact Flows, routing, integrations, APIs, and AWS services.
The successful candidate will be comfortable translating business and customer-service requirements into scalable Amazon Connect solutions and working across development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Core AWS Connect Experience
The candidate should have strong practical experience with:
Amazon Connect architecture, configuration, and administration.
Contact Flows and modular/reusable flow design.
Queues, routing profiles, agents, users, security profiles, and hours of operation.
Contact Centre voice and telephony configuration.
IVR and self-service customer journeys.
Inbound and outbound contact handling.
Customer Profiles and customer data integration.
Contact Trace Records (CTRs) and contact history.
Call recording, monitoring, quality management, and reporting.
Contact Lens and conversational analytics where required.
Prompts, audio, text-to-speech, and speech recognition.
Lambda integrations within Contact Flows.
Amazon Connect APIs and SDKs.
Event-driven integrations using AWS services.
Troubleshooting and performance optimisation of Connect solutions.
Amazon Connect Cases
Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect Cases is required or strongly preferred.
The developer should be able to:
Design case-management journeys around customer interactions.
Configure case templates, fields, statuses, and workflows.
Understand the relationship between contacts, customers, and cases.
Create and update cases through Amazon Connect functionality and APIs.
Integrate Cases with external CRM, case-management, or customer-service platforms.
Design Contact Flows that create, retrieve, update, or associate cases where appropriate.
Support agent workflows involving multiple contacts against a single customer case.
Implement appropriate permissions and access controls for case information.
Troubleshoot case creation, retrieval, and integration issues.
Consider reporting, auditability, and operational requirements when designing case solutions.
Amazon Connect Tasks
Experience with Amazon Connect Tasks should form part of the role.
Responsibilities may include:
Designing task-based agent workflows.
Configuring task routing and queues.
Creating follow-up tasks from customer interactions.
Using Tasks for asynchronous customer-service activities.
Integrating Tasks with Lambda, APIs, CRM platforms, and other AWS services.
Designing workflows where a voice/contact interaction creates subsequent agent work.
Managing task priorities, expiry, routing, and agent assignment.
Troubleshooting task-routing and workflow issues.
Using Tasks alongside Cases to create an end-to-end customer-service journey.
Contact Flows and Customer Journeys

Inbound call flows.
Customer authentication.
IVR menus.
Queue and routing logic.
Customer identification and lookup.
Case lookup and creation.
Task creation.
Agent transfer and escalation.
Callback functionality.
Error handling and fallback journeys.
Business-hours and holiday handling.
Customer data collection.
Lambda/API integration.
Dynamic prompts and attributes.
Secure handling of customer information.
Reusable flow modules and maintainable flow architecture.
Testing and Deployment

Produce technical designs and implementation documentation.
Develop solutions in controlled environments.
Create unit and integration tests.
Test Contact Flows and integrations end-to-end.
Support UAT.
Investigate and resolve defects.
Deploy changes through appropriate CI/CD processes.
Maintain version control and release documentation.

Experience with Amazon Connect Cases.

# Senior Marketing Data Analyst
**About ApprovalMax**
ApprovalMax provides end-to-end accounts payable automation for businesses using cloud accounting systems such as Xero and QuickBooks Online. We have 20,000+ businesses worldwide across 70+ countries, and strong product-market fit built over 8+ years. Our customers, accountants, bookkeepers, and finance teams are risk-averse, non-technical users who rely on us to control how money leaves their business.
***Remote —* applicants must be based in the UK, Portugal, Serbia or Moldova.**
**Role Overview:**
Reporting to the Head of Analytics, you will own the analytical relationship between the Data Team and the Marketing function. This is a dual role, you will do serious analytical work, building the models, dashboards, and insights Marketing relies on, and you will own how Marketing uses data, setting the rhythms, SLAs, and standards that make analytics a genuine partner to the business rather than a service desk. The measurement layer underneath Marketing (attribution, tracking taxonomy, UTM standards, the HubSpot property schema, and the definitions behind the funnel numbers) has grown organically and needs to be rebuilt deliberately. You will be the person who does that, and then keeps it honest.
This isn’t a role where you’ll be handed a brief and asked to execute. You’ll help shape how embedded analytics works at ApprovalMax, with real influence over the model from day one. **8**0% marketing analytics, 20% wider data contribution, including mentoring, standards and best practices across the business.
**Key Responsibilities:**
Marketing Analytics
* Own the analytical relationship with the Marketing function: understand their priorities, anticipate their data needs, and deliver analysis that drives decisions rather than merely informing them.
* Build and maintain the core dashboards, reports, and models Marketing relies on, and take responsibility for their accuracy, freshness, and usability.
* Own the analysis behind the funnel that matters most to the business: visitor → free trial → paid conversion, trial nurture performance, lifecycle-stage progression, and the leading indicators that move them.
* Quantify channel and campaign performance end to end (spend, CAC, payback, pipeline contribution and retained revenue) rather than stopping at platform-reported conversions.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks; make assumptions explicit and deliver useful outputs before perfect data is available.
* Bring cross-functional context to Marketing analysis, combining product usage, subscription revenue, and CRM data to surface insights a channel-level view would miss.
Attribution & Measurement
* Own the rebuild of marketing attribution: agree the model with Marketing and Finance, document its assumptions and known blind spots, and implement it in the warehouse so that one number is produced once and reused everywhere.
* Reconcile platform-reported numbers (ad platforms, GA4, HubSpot) against warehouse truth, and be the person who can explain — credibly and repeatedly — why they differ.
* Build the measurement approach for activity that attribution cannot see cleanly: brand, organic, partner and word-of-mouth. Incrementality and holdout testing where the spend justifies it.
* Design and analyse marketing experiments — landing pages, nurture sequences, pricing and packaging messages — including how success is defined before the test runs.
Tracking Architecture & Data Collection Standards
* Diagnose the tracking we already have, not just the tracking we intend to build: read the existing client-side implementation, cookie and local-storage handling, and referrer behaviour to work out why a channel is misreporting. Our largest single attribution problem today is an oversized Direct segment, and unpicking it is an early priority for this role.
* Own the event taxonomy: what we track, what each event means, what properties it carries, and what it is allowed to be used for.
* Own the Google Tag Manager container (tags, triggers, variables) and the QA process that proves tracking works before and after a release.
* Own the UTM naming standard and the automated compliance checks that enforce it. Per-campaign tagging is done by whoever launches the campaign; you own the standard, the validation, and the report that shows who is out of compliance.
* Specify the dataLayer contract that the website must expose, and the requirements for server-side tracking. You write the spec and verify the result; the implementation in site code and the infrastructure underneath it are built by web engineering.
* Own tracking QA as a standing process, not a one-off project: broken tracking should be detected by a check, not by someone noticing a dashboard looks wrong three weeks later.
Marketing Data Model & Metric Definitions
* Own the custom property schema in HubSpot from a data perspective: which properties exist, what they mean, who writes them, and how they map to the warehouse model. Specify the fields; workflow build sits with Revenue Operations.
* Own the Marketing domain within the Central KPI & Metrics Glossary — MQL, SQL, opportunity, trial, activation, conversion, retention — and bring additions and conflicts to the governance process rather than letting shadow definitions accumulate.
* Make sure that when Marketing, Sales, Finance and Product quote the same metric, they are quoting the same number, and that where they legitimately differ, the difference is documented rather than argued about.
* Ensure new product features, pricing changes, or GTM motions are reflected in metric definitions and dashboards ahead of launch, not after.
Ways of Working with Marketing
* Define and document the working model between the Data Team and Marketing: metric ownership, request intake, turnaround SLAs, escalation paths, and data freshness expectations.
* Establish an explicit fast lane for time-critical marketing requests, so that urgent work can be pulled into the current week rather than waiting for the next planning cycle — and be honest, in writing, about what does not qualify.
* Document domain knowledge, stakeholder preferences, and analytical edge cases so marketing analytics can be handed off or scaled without starting from scratch.
Self-Service, Reporting & AI-Assisted Workflows
* Build and maintain dashboards and automated reports (Lightdash, Amplitude, GA4) so Marketing can answer recurring questions without an analyst in the loop.
* Write clear documentation others can verify, extend, and build on: metric definitions, methodology notes, and data caveats.
* Actively shift recurring analytical work to self-service, freeing your capacity for higher-value analysis.
* Use LLM-assisted tools and AI coding agents as a default part of your analytical workflow — for data exploration, query generation, insight synthesis, and documentation. You should be faster and more thorough because of these tools, not merely aware of them.
* Help embed agentic workflows within the Marketing team, showing stakeholders how to get answers from data directly.
* Contribute as a practitioner and user of the natural-language and text-to-SQL tooling being built by the Data Platform Lead.
Data Quality, Governance & Mentorship
* Flag data quality issues upstream to the Data Platform Lead; understand how your analyses depend on specific pipelines and contracts, and raise risks proactively.
* Treat marketing data quality as your own problem where it originates in taxonomy, tagging, or CRM property design — that is your surface, not the platform team's.
* Participate in the intake and weekly triage process; help classify and scope incoming requests from Marketing.
* Provide technical guidance, analytical framing, and code reviews for junior analysts.
* Contribute to agile workflows (Kanban/Scrum) and planning sessions; keep your work visible and priorities explicit.
* Help shape the documentation standards and analytical norms that will apply as the team scales.
**What We're Looking For:**
**Must Have's:**
* 4+ years’ experience in data analytics, ideally across marketing, growth or GTM
* Experience owning marketing measurement, attribution and tracking
* Strong diagnostic skills across tracking, attribution and data quality
* Hands-on use of AI/LLM tools in your analytical workflow
* Strong SQL and Python skills, including production-quality code
* Experience with GA4, GTM, CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) and paid media data
* Experience with BI/product analytics tools such as Lightdash, Looker or Amplitude
* Ability to combine data across CRM, product, finance and marketing
* Strong communication skills with senior, non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with metric governance and resolving conflicting data
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex questions into actionable insights
**Nice to Have:**
* SaaS/B2B experience and familiarity with subscription & PLG metrics.
* Experience with product-led growth, activation and conversion analysis
* Familiarity with dbt, semantic layers and data modelling
* Experience with server-side tracking or dataLayer implementation
* Exposure to experimentation, incrementality or media-mix modelling
* Experience with embedded analytics models
* Exposure to LLMs, text-to-SQL or AI-driven data exploration
* Experience mentoring analysts or setting analytical standards
**What We Offer:**
* Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend
* Home Office Setup - one off £500 reimbursement, post probation
* 26 days of paid time off
* 1 additional day off for your birthday
* Service-years recognition financial reward
* Regular performance-based compensation reviews
* Growing international business with 20,000+ subscribers

**Join Our Dynamic Team as a Project Manager!** 🌟
Are you passionate about telecoms? Do you thrive in a fast‐paced, innovative environment? At Babble, we’re on a mission to be our customers’ most trusted advisor for cloud‐based technologies. We’re looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our dynamic team. If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!
**What will you be doing?**
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering assigned projects in alignment with corporate standards and PMO methodologies. The role ensures that project objectives are achieved within agreed scope, timelines, budgets, and quality thresholds.
Working closely with sponsors, cross‐functional teams, and PMO leadership, the Project Manager coordinates daily delivery activities, manages risks and issues, and ensures consistent reporting and documentation. This position operates under the direction of the Head of Corporate PMO and contributes to the organisation’s overall strategic execution capability.
**Key Responsibilities**
Project Planning and Initiation
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Develop detailed project plans, including schedules, work breakdown structures, roles, and responsibilities.
* Prepare project charters and ensure alignment with PMO templates and approval processes.
Project Execution and Coordination
* Lead and coordinate project team activities, ensuring progress against the approved plan.
* Manage day‐to‐day project operations, deliverable quality, and stakeholder communications.
* Ensure all project activity follows PMO methodology, standards, and documentation requirements.
Monitoring, Reporting, and Governance Compliance
* Track project progress, including tasks, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Prepare regular project status reports for the Programme Manager or Head of PMO.
* Support PMO governance requirements, including stage gates, approvals, and documentation audits.
Risk, Issue, and Change Management
* Identify risks, issues, and variances early, updating mitigation and response plans accordingly.
* Escalate critical risks or delays to PMO leadership in a timely manner.
* Manage approved scope changes in line with PMO procedures.
* Ensure impacts to budget, timeline, and quality are documented and clearly communicated.
Stakeholder Management and Communication
* Maintain proactive communication with sponsors, contributors, and impacted teams.
* Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed and information remains transparent and up to date.
* Prepare stakeholder communication materials, including plans, summaries, and presentations.
* Facilitate collaboration across business units and technical teams.
Project Closure and Lessons Learned
* Ensure appropriate handover of deliverables to operational teams.
* Complete project closure documentation and contribute to PMO lessons‐learned activities.
* Confirm achievement of project objectives and identify any remaining follow‐up actions.
## Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, IT, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in project management or PMO roles.
* Proven experience managing and delivering cross‐functional projects within an organisational environment.
* Strong planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Solid understanding of project management methodologies and governance frameworks.
* Proficiency in project management and reporting tools (e.g. MS Project, Excel, PPM systems, Power BI).

This is a value-creation mandate, not a turnaround. . You will take the business into a new market, with the United Kingdom as the primary prize. The product has to remain the primary competitive advantage, the recurring revenue base has to be protected, and the opportunity to create structural distance through AI is real.
You will own the UK client and partner relationships, build the commercial motion from the ground up, and partner with the CEO and product and technology leader to ensure the platform addresses the needs of the UK market.
You will have substantial authority over the execution of the agreed UK strategy. Key commercial development decisions, including market positioning, target segments, pricing, partnerships, resource allocation, and major commercial commitments, will be decided jointly with the CEO.
You will do this with the long-term backing of a permanent-capital owner, free from the pressure to flip the business.

**Commercial & Revenue Growth**

* Own the execution of WIZE's UK strategy, market positioning, and competitive response in the wealth management software market.
* Drive UK revenue and ARR growth with direct accountability across new customer acquisition, expansion, pricing execution, and the development of recurring revenue.
* Build and execute the UK go-to-market motion from the ground up: local presence, bank and partner relationships, and a repeatable pipeline where little exists today.
* Serve as the primary executive relationship owner for key UK clients, bank partners, and influencers, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and contract renewal.
* Develop and deepen strategic partnerships across private banks, discretionary fund managers, and the wider UK wealth management ecosystem.
* Anticipate client needs and proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's footprint within existing UK
* Identify AI-driven opportunities to reposition the product and create durable competitive distance within the WealthTech vertical, working with the CEO and product and technology leader to assess and prioritise them.

* Represent the needs of the UK market in product roadmap discussions, ensuring that market feedback reflects the needs of boutique wealth managers and the competitive dynamics of the Portfolio Management Systems market.
* Contribute to a credible AI roadmap. AI must be embedded as a genuine operational and product advantage, not a roadmap line item.
* Champion AI-first product thinking, identifying where automation, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows create durable differentiation for UK clients.
* Partner closely with the CEO and CPTO so that the roadmap, packaging, and pricing tiers align tightly with UK commercial needs.
* Gather structured feedback from UK prospects, clients, and partners and translate it into clear commercial and product recommendations.

* Define and implement the UK commercial development strategy jointly with the CEO.

The Managing Director we are looking for is a commercially-led WealthTech operator with deep roots in the UK wealth management software market who leads with an AI-first mindset and is energised by the opportunity to create real, lasting business value.
You have personally owned a revenue number, built a commercial motion where none existed, and opened a new geography from scratch.

## Lead Product Designer (UX/UI & Research) **London (Hybrid) | Contract | Start ASAP with potential for growth into our full time vacancy | Competitive salary** The role
We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability.
Join Bite as our first in-house designer, initially for a 6 month contract, but with the potential to grow into our full time vacancy. Working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment.
## **Why join Bite**
**The problem is genuinely hard.** When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product.
**You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it.** We're a small, agile, product-led team so if we need to pivot, we will prototype, test and build rapidly. You won’t find a feature factory or dependency delays here.
**Your work ships to people who pay.** The platform beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions.
## **What we're building**
Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.
Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. *"I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?"* and propagation of the detected changes to all affected files.
## **What you’ll do**
* Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality.
* Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns.
* Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint.
* Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap.

**Job Description – Change Management Lead 6 Months contract**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Change Management Lead to drive the people, process and organisational change agenda across complex business and technology transformation programmes within the telecommunications sector.
The role will be responsible for developing and executing an integrated change strategy that enables impacted teams to understand, adopt and sustain new ways of working. The successful candidate will work closely with programme leadership, business stakeholders, technology teams, operational functions, communications, learning and development, and external delivery partners.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the end-to-end change management strategy and delivery plan aligned with programme objectives, milestones and business outcomes.
* Conduct change impact assessments across people, processes, technology, organisation structures, roles, capabilities and ways of working.
* Identify impacted stakeholder groups and develop targeted stakeholder engagement and communication plans.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior business leaders, programme sponsors, operational teams, technology functions and delivery partners.
* Establish and manage a network of business change champions across impacted functions and locations.
* Assess organisational readiness and identify adoption risks, resistance points, capability gaps and dependencies.
* Define clear change interventions to address identified impacts and support successful business adoption.
* Develop compelling change narratives that explain the purpose, benefits, impact and expected outcomes of the transformation.
* Work with communications teams to create clear, audience-specific communications across appropriate channels.
* Partner with learning and development teams and subject-matter experts to define training needs, learning journeys and knowledge-transfer plans.
* Ensure business teams are adequately prepared for solution releases, process changes, operating-model changes and transition to business-as-usual operations.
* Integrate change activities with programme plans, release schedules, deployment roadmaps and operational-readiness plans.
* Support leaders and line managers in communicating change, managing resistance and reinforcing desired behaviours.
* Define adoption measures and track change effectiveness through readiness assessments, stakeholder sentiment, training completion, usage, compliance and benefit-realisation indicators.
* Provide regular change status reporting, insights, risks and recommendations to programme governance and senior leadership.
* Ensure change activities are sustainable and embedded beyond implementation through reinforcement, coaching and post-deployment support.
* Promote consistent change management standards, governance, templates and best practices across the programme.
**Required Experience**
* Significant experience leading change management for large, complex business and technology transformation programmes.
* Strong experience within telecommunications, technology, digital services or another large-scale, highly regulated environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing change across multiple business units, functions, locations and stakeholder groups.
* Experience supporting transformations involving areas such as customer operations, digital channels, network operations, service management, OSS/BSS, cloud, data, automation or operating-model change.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior executives, programme sponsors and operational leaders.
* Experience working within complex programme structures involving internal teams, strategic suppliers and multiple delivery partners.
* Strong understanding of change impact assessment, stakeholder management, communications, training, business readiness, adoption and benefits realisation.
* Experience using recognised change methodologies such as Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter, Lewin or an equivalent enterprise change framework.
* Ability to translate complex technology and programme information into clear business messages for different audiences.
* Experience managing resistance and supporting teams through uncertainty and significant organisational change.
**Skills and Competencies**
* Strategic change leadership
* Stakeholder engagement and executive influencing
* Change impact and readiness assessment
* Organisational design and operating-model awareness
* Communication and engagement planning
* Training and capability-development planning
* Business adoption and benefits realisation
* Change governance, reporting and risk management
* Strong facilitation, presentation and workshop-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities and complex dependencies
* Collaborative leadership across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, management, organisational development, human resources, communications, technology or a related discipline.
* Change management certification such as Prosci, APMG Change Management, CCMP or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
* Programme or project management certification such as PRINCE2, MSP, PMP, Agile or SAFe would be advantageous.
**Desirable Experience**
* Experience delivering change within a global telecommunications organisation.
* Understanding of the telecommunications value chain, including customer experience, order management, service fulfilment, service assurance, billing and network operations.
* Experience supporting Agile, product-led or scaled delivery environments.
* Experience with workforce transformation, organisational restructuring, process simplification or capability uplift.
* Familiarity with digital adoption, change analytics and employee-engagement tools.
* Experience supporting major platform migrations, service transitions or enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.
**Measures of Success**
* Business readiness achieved in line with programme and release milestones.
* High levels of stakeholder engagement and leadership alignment.
* Effective completion of communications, training and readiness activities.
* Measurable adoption of new systems, processes and ways of working.
* Reduction in resistance, operational disruption and post-deployment issues.
* Successful transition of change into business-as-usual operations.
* Achievement and sustained realisation of intended programme benefits.
### Information Security Responsibilities
* Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
* Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
* Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
* Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in helping keep millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. This is a career where no two days are the same, and where your actions can have a lasting impact on individuals, families and communities.
Whether you're supporting a vulnerable person in crisis, helping reunite a child with their family, responding to an emergency, investigating crime or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life, you'll be making a meaningful difference to people every day.
You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and thrive in your career.
We offer one of the highest starting salaries for Police Constables across England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

We recognise that a successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, strong family-friendly policies, ongoing development opportunities and a range of wellbeing initiatives designed to support you both professionally and personally.
* **Starting salary:** £32,472, rising year on year to £50,256 after five years
* **London allowances:** £8,738 (£5,588 London Allowance plus £3,150 London Weighting) from day one of training
* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
* A highly competitive Career Average Revalued Earnings (CARE) pension scheme
* Voucher and incentive schemes, including cycle-to-work and a wide range of retail discounts
* Continued investment in learning, supported by dedicated in-house talent and development teams
* Clear promotion and career development opportunities across a range of policing specialisms
* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests
* Eligibility for the Blue Light Card
* Membership of the Police Federation from day one

* You have been unsuccessful following your application, testing or interview for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO and have not yet completed the three-month reapplication period.
* You have been unsuccessful following BTP vetting checks within the last 12 months.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence, including suspended sentences.
* You have previously been dismissed from another police force or are subject to a live misconduct investigation.
* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.
## # What we're looking for
You don't need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.
Whether you're changing careers, returning to work, leaving education or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed.
We know that great police officers come from all walks of life. Some join us straight from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, retail, customer service, hospitality, the military and many other professions. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a positive difference, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Good judgement and problem-solving ability**
* **Empathy and emotional resilience**
* **The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure**

As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, move into a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.

Applications are completed online.

## You'll design the systems and experiences behind a great employee journey at bunny.net.
**About bunny.net**
Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.
At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.
You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.
We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.
Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

As a People Experience & Ops Specialist, you’ll improve the systems behind the employee journey, from onboarding and lifecycle operations to process design, automation, and culture.

* Make the employee journey feel intentional at every stage

* Clear communication with employees, managers, and leadership alike

* Comfort working async in a fast-moving, evolving environment

* Experience with HRIS, survey tools, or workflow automation

* Experience working in a remote-first or distributed org
* You use AI tools to work smarter, not just faster
**Where should you be located?**
> In Europe, or ideally within CET ±5 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.
**What's in it for you?**
Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.
* **100% flexible hours -** Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.
* **Remote-first by design** - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

* Work closely with clinical scientists, statisticians, project managers, and third-party clients, valuing their expertise and adjusting your approach based on what actually helps the study, not just your own workflow

## **Build exceptional projects. Build your future.**
At Careys, we’re proud to deliver some of the most complex and high‐profile civil engineering projects across the UK. We are now looking for a **Site Engineer** to join our team and play a key role in delivering safe, high‐quality and technically excellent work on site.
If you enjoy problem‐solving, being hands‐on, working with great people and shaping real‐world infrastructure, this is a fantastic opportunity.
## What you will do:
### **Setting Out & Technical Delivery**
* Carry out accurate setting out using a variety of surveying equipment.
* Check levels, dimensions and tolerances to ensure work is completed correctly.
* Support the Senior Engineer in resolving technical queries and RFIs.
* Review drawings, raise issues early, and help ensure work is buildable and compliant.

* Work closely with Site Managers and Supervisors to plan and sequence works.
* Provide clear construction information to the workforce, including sketches and mark‐ups.
* Monitor progress and provide input into short‐term planning.

* Maintain accurate as‐built records and support digital deliverables.
* Help prepare Inspection & Test Plans and carry out quality checks on site.
* Identify issues early and support the resolution of non‐conformances.
### **Material & Temporary Works Support**
* Carry out material checks and ensure correct testing and sampling procedures.
* Assist with take‐offs and scheduling of key materials such as drainage, reinforcement and waterbars.
* Complete temporary works inspections and support simple temporary works designs.
### **Leadership & Collaboration**
* Supervise Apprentice and Graduate Engineers, offering day‐to‐day guidance.
* Work closely with subcontractors and suppliers to support safe and efficient delivery.
* Build strong relationships internally and externally to keep information flowing.

* Strong communication and problem‐solving skills.
* Solid civil engineering knowledge with the ability to interpret drawings and specifications.
* Experience using digital tools, including AutoCAD/BricsCAD.
* Confident surveying and setting‐out skills.
* Experience in inspection, testing and quality assurance of construction materials.
* **4+ years’ experience** on major civil engineering projects (infrastructure, rail, highways or utilities).
* **HNC or above** in Civil or Structural Engineering.
## Benefits
Working at Careys means joining a **people‐first, purpose‐driven organisation** that genuinely invests in you and your career. Here’s what you can expect: **✔ Career Growth & Development**
* Clear progression pathways
* Extensive internal training (including structured Engineering development programmes)
* Opportunities to work on high‐profile, technically challenging projects
### **✔ Strong Team Culture**
* Supportive, highly skilled engineering teams
* A collaborative, friendly environment where you can ask questions, learn and grow
* Leadership that values humility, respect and authenticity

* Company car or car allowance (role‐dependent)
* Private healthcare options
* Generous pension contributions
* Life assurance and wellbeing support
* Cycle‐to‐work scheme and other employee perks
### **✔ Meaningful Work**
* Projects that shape communities and national infrastructure
* A commitment to high standards of safety, quality and sustainability
* A business that genuinely cares about social value and long‐term positive impact

Our story starts in 1969 with three brothers and a van. Throughout the years, we have remained committed to delivering on our promises, respecting our clients, offering innovative solutions and producing the highest-quality work in safe environments. These are the core principles set by our Founders, the ones we have never wavered from and they help us to fulfil our ultimate vision to be the most trusted and socially responsible construction company, that people are proud to work with. Our strong approach is underpinned by robust financial management, continuous investment in our people, specialist equipment and strategic assets and our long-standing culture of teamwork – we want to create the very best environments for our people. We care about our people and our partners and how we work with them, ensuring we do our best by them. Time in a small team where the roadmap changed under your feet and you were fine about it.
Something you built for yourself because it annoyed you that it didn't exist.

job_description:
We have an exciting opening for a Junior Print Designer to join us at Renfold. This role is ideally suited to an established Assistant Print Designer who is ready to take the next step, or a Junior Print Designer looking to broaden their experience in a fast-moving, multi-brand environment.
You will help curate commercially relevant ranges and develop original print across our multi-gender, off-price brands and collections, spanning fashion, home and accessories across Ladies, Mens and Kids.
We are looking for someone who can help build, shape and accelerate our emerging fashion brands, balancing trend and newness with strong commercial awareness. This is an ideal role for someone with creative instincts, initiative and the ability to execute quickly and resourcefully.
You will report to the Senior Designer and work as part of a small, growing team. This is a full-time, permanent role with flexi-hours. The role is office-based during probation, followed by hybrid working with three office days per week after successful completion of probation. Salary is competitive and dependent on experience.
Role Overview
As Junior Print Designer, you will play a key role in creating trend-inspired, elevated and commercially relevant prints that reflect each brand's identity and customer. Working closely with the Senior Designer, Commercial Manager and wider cross-functional teams, you will support the development of cohesive ranges from initial research and concept through to production-ready artwork and approval. You will manage defined print briefs and smaller areas of the range independently, while receiving support and development as you take on greater ownership.
Success in the role will mean delivering commercially relevant print options on brief and on time; producing accurate, production-ready artwork and approval comments; maintaining organised print libraries and trackers; and building strong working relationships with internal teams, customers and suppliers.
Key Responsibilities
Trend & Market Strategy and Analysis: Conduct ongoing trend, competitor and market research to inform seasonal print direction and maintain commercial relevance. Create clear visual presentations and confidently share ideas with the design team and senior stakeholders.
Print Design and Development: Create original, commercially relevant prints using hand-drawn, painted and digital techniques. Develop seamless repeats, placements, engineered prints and colourways appropriate to the product, customer and price point.
Drive Newness in Print and Range Curation: Work with the Senior Designer and Commercial Manager to curate cohesive, seasonally appropriate ranges that balance trend, newness, customer needs and proven commercial print handwriting.
Decipher Print Trends: Identify and prioritise the key print directions and commercial print stories that will drive the seasonal assortment across the relevant brands and categories.
Production-Ready Artwork and Approvals: Prepare accurate artwork, CADs, colourways, specifications and print information for sampling and production, including Pantone references where required. Support strike-off, lab-dip and sample approvals, ensuring colour, scale and design intent are maintained throughout development.
Collaboration & Cross-Functional Relationships: Partner closely with commercial, design and buying, colleagues to align print and design decisions with customer, cost, quality and delivery requirements.
Technical and Administrative Support: Produce print and shape tech packs, assist in fit and sample review sessions, maintain organised artwork and print libraries, support approvals and prepare for customer and internal meetings.
Supplier Communication: Communicate effectively with global factories and suppliers, responding promptly to queries and supporting the resolution of technical or production issues.
Fabric & Sustainability: Apply a practical understanding of fabrications, print techniques and production limitations. Support the selection of options that meet sustainability, quality and price requirements while driving newness.
Workflow Management: Manage allocated briefs and approvals against the critical path, maintain accurate trackers and files, and communicate progress, risks and changes clearly to the wider team.
An established Assistant Print Designer ready to step into a Junior role, or experience at Junior Print Designer level.
A strong portfolio demonstrating original print development, hand-drawing and painting techniques, digital design, repeat patterns, colourways and commercial application.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with confident CAD skills and the ability to work accurately at pace.
Experience creating seamless repeats and preparing production-ready print artwork and specifications.
A good understanding of colour, scale, placement, Pantone references, print techniques and how artwork translates across different products and fabrications.
Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how brand identity and customer needs inform print and range decisions.
Good knowledge of brand identity and experience working across multiple brands at the same time.
Excellent organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple briefs, projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Clear communication and collaborative working skills, including confidence presenting ideas and communicating with suppliers.
A proactive, resourceful approach and willingness to contribute across creative, technical and administrative tasks.
Experience within off-price retail or a fast-paced supplier, retailer or multi-brand environment would be advantageous.
Experience working across fashion, experience in home and/or accessories would be advantageous.
Experience communicating with overseas factories and reviewing strike-offs, lab dips and production samples would be advantageous.
Awareness of responsible materials, lower-impact print processes and commercial sustainability considerations would be advantageous.
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Occasional attendance at customer, supplier or industry meetings may be required.

# Biodiversity Data and Projects Officer (Buckinghamshire Council)

### Overview
We are passionate about protecting and enhancing biodiversity across Buckinghamshire and Milton Keynes through the collection, analysis and application of environmental data.
Are you enthusiastic about biodiversity data and biological recording? Do you want to make a difference through data, conservation projects and species-focused work? Do you have species identification skills?
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Biodiversity Data and Projects Officer to join the Buckinghamshire and Milton Keynes Environmental Records Centre (BMERC). This role combines specialist ecological and species knowledge with technical data processing and reporting skills to help deliver key projects and strategic objectives.
If you are looking for a varied role where you can make a meaningful contribution to nature conservation, we would be pleased to hear from you.
### About the Role
You will become an expert user of our new Orca environmental records database, developing knowledge of the full data lifecycle, including data collation, import, quality assurance, verification, reporting and analysis. This work will support BMERC’s environmental records service and data exchange agreements.
You will also manage and deliver a variety of projects, ranging from surveys of specialist local species to the development of GIS mapping resources for volunteer recorder groups. Strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills will be important for successful delivery.
The role is based at the Council Offices in Aylesbury, with hybrid working available for up to three days per week. Some field visits and survey work may also be required.
### About the Team
BMERC’s mission is to provide a high-performing, sustainable environmental records service that supports the protection of biodiversity, habitats, and sites of biological and geological importance across Buckinghamshire and Milton Keynes.
The team manages an environmental database containing more than 3.6 million records and undertakes a wide range of activities, including data management, project delivery, volunteer training and support, stakeholder engagement, landowner advice, specialist ecological surveys, and recommendations on Local Wildlife Site designation.
BMERC is one of five environmental specialist teams within the Planning and Environment Service and works closely with the Council’s Ecology Team. We maintain records of flora, fauna, designated and non-designated wildlife and geological sites, wildlife corridors, Road Verge Nature Reserves, Habitats of Principal Importance and other priority conservation areas.
Working with us offers the opportunity to make a lasting positive impact on wildlife and people across Buckinghamshire and Milton Keynes.
### About You
We are looking for an enthusiastic, self-motivated individual who can work independently and as part of a team. You will have experience in a relevant professional field and specialist knowledge of environmental data, species taxonomy and identification.
You will be passionate about wildlife conservation, biological recording and effective data management, with a commitment to collaborative working with colleagues, stakeholders and the public. Strong ICT skills and an interest in GIS technologies are essential.
You will hold a full driving licence and be able to work across Buckinghamshire and Milton Keynes when required. You will also be organised, able to prioritise competing demands and capable of meeting deadlines.

About the Government Legal Department
From healthcare to artificial intelligence, energy to national security, we provide legal advice to government departments on nation-changing subjects.
At Government Legal Department we have a vital, single-minded purpose: to help the Government govern well within the rule of law. This is complemented by our exciting vision to be an outstanding legal organisation, committed to the highest standards of service and professionalism and a brilliant place to work where we can all thrive and fulfill our potential.
Our work touches almost every aspect of public life. We are the largest provider of legal services across government, working on high profile matters.
Our respected professionals are involved in everything from regulation and litigation to advice on drafting legislation. They provide expertise to the full range of government departments. We are at the heart of delivering the government’s priorities and our success depends on our people.
GLD is a non-ministerial government department headed by the Treasury Solicitor, our Permanent Secretary, and employs nearly 3000 people, including over 2600 legal professionals. We have offices nationwide, in Bristol, Leeds, inner and outer London and Manchester. Our lawyers can also be located within other departments and overseas.
GLD also depends on a range of cross-government professionals to provide our corporate services. These play an essential part in helping GLD to achieve its purpose and truly deliver much more than law.
This is an exciting time to join GLD, with cutting edge legal work on global issues and a transformation agenda which is ensuring the Department exemplifies the Modern Civil Service.

### Job description
**The Digital, Data and Cyber Team is transforming the way GLD works through modern technology, data and digital services.**
We are building a modern digital workplace that empowers our people, strengthens collaboration and enables the organisation to operate efficiently, securely and sustainably.
Through agile delivery and user-centred approaches, we design and deliver products and services in partnership with the people who use them, ensuring solutions meet real needs and deliver lasting value.
As part of the wider Government Digital and Data profession, we play a key role in transforming how government operates, enabling better outcomes for colleagues, stakeholders and the public we serve.

This role sits in Digital and Data’s Digital Delivery team, which is responsible for the maintenance and continuous improvement of GLD’s existing digital services, and the development of new digital services to support GLD staff working across government. * Managing the delivery, support and continuous improvement of larger, more complex products and services at various stages of the product life cycle, ensuring they are being delivered to government standards.
* Line managing and supporting more junior delivery managers.
* Building an internal delivery manager community to standardise ways of working, ensure best practise, learn, share and apply skills and knowledge to improve.
* Leading and motivating multidisciplinary teams, facilitating an inclusive team environment where innovation and challenge are welcomed, and identifying and resolving any issues with team dynamics and collaboration.
* Leading agile meetings including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, show and tells, retrospectives and facilitating related activity.
* Helping teams to focus on delivering to agreed goals, identifying and communicating risks, issues, dependencies and removing blockers where necessary.

* Overseeing projects run by external suppliers, ensuring that they are providing value for money, and delivering outcomes on time, to budget and in line with the Service Standard.
* Supporting the Head of Digital Delivery with overall project and resource planning, including demand management and transition into live service.
